sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's unbeaten run came to an end on Tuesday 13 October as they lost 3–1 at home to Stockport County. Despite the defeat, Sandbach remain top of the First Division South with 28 points from 12 games, though their record now shows two losses from their 12 matches played.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth face Market Drayton Town on Tuesday evening; Drayton are struggling in 12th place with just one win in their last five league games, while Bridgnorth sit fourth and have won three of their last five. Foley Meir host Cheadle Heath Nomads, with Foley in mid-table and Nomads near the foot of the division. Crewe play Widnes Town at home on Tuesday night, with both sides fighting at the lower end—Crewe are 16th on 12 points while Widnes sit bottom with just 6 points from 10 games. Stafford Town remain second with 24 points, while Bilston Town and AFC Bridgnorth are closely matched in third and fourth respectively. Barnton continue to impress in sixth, and Allscott Heath have moved into ninth after a strong run of recent form.
